articles.title_en: Spain’s prime minister blames networks linked to Russia and Israel for spreading fake news about Ceuta migration crisis
articles.lead_en: The investigation into what caused the migration crisis in Ceuta is still underway, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said on Cadena Ser radio, but social media has already been flooded with fake news and disinformation.
